Create the STAC database schema

Source: R/db.R
stac_db_setup.Rd

Idempotently creates the stac_collections and stac_items tables and all required indexes. Requires the PostGIS extension to be available.

Usage

stac_db_setup(con)

Arguments

con

A DBI connection, or a pool::dbPool() object. A pool is recommended for long-running servers — see stac_api_router().

Value

con, invisibly.

Details

CREATE EXTENSION postgis needs elevated privileges. On managed PostgreSQL services PostGIS is usually pre-installed and the connecting role is not a superuser, so a failure to create the extension is tolerated as long as PostGIS is actually present; only a genuinely missing PostGIS aborts.
